people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Baal-hazor
people.line: Place where Absalom sheared his sheep.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: City near the Judean wilderness; Jesus withdrew there

translations.web: After two full years, Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
translations.bsb: Two years later, when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal-hazor near Ephraim, he invited all the sons of the king.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
